## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(map): …`, `fix(auth): …`) — it becomes the merge commit
- [ ] Base branch is `staging` (or `main` only for a release from `staging` / a `hotfix/…`)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (format, analyze, test)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new behaviour
- [ ] Ran it on the iOS simulator
- [ ] Privacy: no non-user contact data stored; permissions asked at point of use
- [ ] `place` and `visit` kept as separate concepts
